title: Morning Brief
intro_md: Friday, Oct 9, 2026. Type "more on G3" (or any code) in chat with April, or tap More info and paste the request there, for a deeper dive.

items.headline_md: Houthi attacks on Riyadh's main airport kill three Saudis, including a Saudia pilot
items.summary_md: Saudi aviation officials say two strikes Thursday hit King Khalid International Airport's facilities and a Saudia aircraft; the Saudi-led coalition vows a 'firm' response.

items.headline_md: Update: Trump says the US won't attack Iran before the Nov. 3 midterms
items.summary_md: A day after saying he'd consider renewed strikes, he called talks with Tehran 'productive' and said the naval blockade stays in place.

items.headline_md: Former ICC judge Navi Pillay wins the Nobel Peace Prize
items.summary_md: The Nobel committee credited the South African jurist, a former UN human rights chief, with making sure war crimes and genocide get prosecuted.

items.headline_md: Update: Hurricane Isaias, now Category 2, nears a Gulf Coast landfall late Friday
items.summary_md: With 105 mph winds, it's most likely to hit near the Alabama-Florida line with life-threatening surge in Pensacola Bay; thousands of National Guard troops are deploying.

items.headline_md: Pentagon says the firing-squad execution of Fort Hood gunman Nidal Hasan will be livestreamed
items.summary_md: It's believed it would be the first public US execution in almost a century, and a legal expert calls it 'uncertain legal terrain.'

items.headline_md: Anti-migrant violence erupts in Soweto and Durban
items.summary_md: Police say at least 24 vehicles were torched and foreign-owned shops looted amid anger over a court ruling letting some undocumented migrants apply for asylum.

items.headline_md: ICE agents shoot and wound a man in his car with a 5-year-old inside in New York City
items.summary_md: Mayor Zohran Mamdani says talks with Trump to free the man failed; federal agents have shot at least 21 people since Trump returned to office.

items.headline_md: Delta misses on earnings for the first time in two years and slashes its 2026 outlook on fuel
items.summary_md: Full-year adjusted EPS is now seen at $5.10 to $5.60 (from $6.50 to $7.50), though CEO Ed Bastian says demand is holding up despite higher fares.

items.headline_md: Starbucks has reportedly explored buying Chipotle
items.summary_md: The FT says CEO Brian Niccol's company worked with advisers on a bid for the chain he used to run; Chipotle rose about 6% and Starbucks fell about 3% Thursday.

items.headline_md: Nvidia-backed Firmus scraps a $30bn-valuation IPO that would have been one of Australia's biggest
items.summary_md: The AI data-centre builder, whose clients include OpenAI and Meta, blamed market volatility and will seek private money instead.

items.headline_md: Labor Department suspends Microsoft and Adobe from its green-card labor program
items.summary_md: It also stopped processing new applications from Infosys, Tata, Wipro, Cognizant and others, citing active federal investigations into Microsoft and Adobe.

items.headline_md: Bessent hires Judy Shelton, whose Fed nomination the Senate blocked, as a Treasury adviser
items.summary_md: She'll advise on currency policy with a focus on China's financial conditions.

items.headline_md: Ubisoft is shutting down Rainbow Six Mobile seven months after its global launch
items.summary_md: The game, built over six and a half years by 11 Ubisoft studios plus Tencent, stays playable until Jan. 15, 2027.

items.headline_md: US game spending fell 9% in August to $4.3B, dragged by an 18% drop in mobile
items.summary_md: Circana has NBA 2K27 on top of the charts, while Monopoly Go, Royal Match and Candy Crush Saga were the top three mobile games.

items.headline_md: This week's mobile launches include a Zynga dice board game test and Crossy Road Rush
items.summary_md: Zynga is testing the dice game on Android in the US and Puerto Rico, and Netflix's The Conjuring: Unspoken (Oct 13) uses your phone as the controller.

items.headline_md: Xbox names Maria Angelidou-Smith CEO of Mojang and Minecraft
items.summary_md: She previously held senior product roles at Meta, Personio and Reddit, and takes over as Kayleen Walters moves to lead the new XP division.

items.headline_md: Sony is transferring 419 VR patents to Meta
items.summary_md: The deal, signed in December 2025, includes 180 US patents, adding to signs that Sony is winding down its VR push.

items.headline_md: Witcher 3 Remastered gets a big patch, with a Switch 2 fix for blurry visuals coming soon
items.summary_md: Patch 5.01 is out on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series; CD Projekt says Switch 2 details are due in the following days.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: still no public repo or release from the r/decomps general Wii U lifter in GitHub searches this morning; r/decomps and r/emulation couldn't be read (Reddit returned 403). No verified Switch 2 commercial-game emulation news.

items.headline_md: A static recompilation turns Switch game Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream into a native PC program
items.summary_md: RussoPhone/tomodachi-ltd-recomp, posted Oct 8, translates the game's ARM64 code to C with Vulkan graphics and no CPU emulation; it needs your own v1.0.0 dump, is Linux-first (Windows experimental), and the author says they've stepped back and want maintainers.

items.headline_md: Update: AnyPS5 now covers 100% of the PS5's GPU shader instructions
items.summary_md: All 1,166 tracked instructions are recognized by its PS5-to-PC relinker, but system libraries sit near 85%, so broad game compatibility isn't here yet.

items.headline_md: PS5SX2 2.0 brings frame generation and up to 8x resolution to PS2 games on jailbroken PS5s
items.summary_md: The native PCSX2 port also adds PS2 online play, four-player support and save states; it needs a jailbroken console and your own PS2 BIOS.

items.headline_md: Azahar 2126.2 patches a 3DS emulator hole that let crafted CIA files run code on your PC
items.summary_md: The release also fixes large eShop downloads and an xBRZ filter bug on Vulkan; the team says to update soon.

items.headline_md: Update: Other Mommy opens today to harsh early reactions but is still expected to win the weekend (Oct 9-11)
items.summary_md: Universal projects about $20M from 3,200 theaters for the $19M Jessica Chastain horror film, while THR's critic called it 'mostly vacuous.'

items.headline_md: Verity led Wednesday (Oct 7) with $2.42M for a $40.4M domestic total
items.summary_md: Resident Evil was second ($129.1M after 20 days) and Spider-Man: Brand New Day reached $955.2M.

items.headline_md: A live-action Cyberpunk 2077 movie is in the works at Paramount
items.summary_md: Transformers producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura is reportedly attached, and CD Projekt's co-CEO confirmed the partnership on X.

items.headline_md: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East has become a $342M smash in China
items.summary_md: Variety talks to director Wen Muye about the war story of a Shenyang cook played by Shen Teng.

items.headline_md: UK and Irish cinema-going is up 21% on 2025, its best growth since the pandemic
items.summary_md: A London Film Festival panel credited Spider-Man, The Odyssey and audience appetite for original films.

items.headline_md: Warner Bros. international chief Gerhard Zeiler exits Skydance for politics in Austria
items.summary_md: His farewell note came days after the $110B Skydance deal closed.

items.headline_md: OpenAI tells investors its annualized revenue is near $50B, about $20B below earlier reports
items.summary_md: The FT says the $70B figure came from investors trying to match Anthropic's method, which counts cloud partners' sales; AI stocks fell Thursday on the news.

items.headline_md: OpenAI stands by firing three safety researchers, citing a 'breach of trust'
items.summary_md: It says Jasmine Wang, Tomek Korbak and Mikita Balesni broke rules on sensitive information, not that they were fired for speaking out, as their open letter claims.

items.headline_md: Google launches a 'universal' Gemini agent for businesses
items.summary_md: It works in the background across Workspace, Slack and Microsoft 365 and can act as a 'coworker agent' with its own email; it's in private preview.

items.headline_md: Anthropic offers open-source projects free AI security scans
items.summary_md: OSS Scanner uses its strongest models, including Claude Mythos, but reports aren't human-reviewed and may be wrong.

items.headline_md: AI leaderboard Arena raises $200M at a $3.1B valuation
items.summary_md: That nearly doubles its value in 10 months; Lightspeed and Khosla led, and it now also scores models on behaviors like lying.

items.headline_md: USA Today sues OpenAI for more than $250M over training on its articles
items.summary_md: It alleges OpenAI copied 'hundreds of thousands' of articles from USA Today and its local papers.

items.headline_md: SpaceX buys 800 MHz spectrum to make Starlink Mobile a 'major mobile carrier'
items.summary_md: The Grain Management deal needs FCC approval and sent AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile shares sharply lower.

items.headline_md: Apple sets a 'Welcome home' event for Oct 13, with touchscreen MacBook Pros reportedly following around Oct 27
items.summary_md: Home products are expected next week; Bloomberg says a new iPad mini and the first touchscreen MacBook Pros come later in the month.

items.headline_md: Global PC shipments plunged 20.1% in Q3, IDC says
items.summary_md: Mac shipments fell 11% to 5.9 million, but Apple's share rose to 9.5%.

items.headline_md: New York alleges TikTok gave some teens a fake 'Algo Refresh' safety feature
items.summary_md: Its lawsuit says users in an experiment thought they'd reset their feeds, but nothing changed.

items.headline_md: Microsoft 365 Family will share Copilot AI with everyone on the plan, but OneDrive shrinks to a shared 2TB
items.summary_md: Storage moves from 1TB per person to a 2TB pool after your first renewal after May 2, 2027.

items.headline_md: AMD will bring FSR 4 upscaling to handhelds by the end of 2026
items.summary_md: AMD's Jack Huynh says both new and existing chips will get it.

items.headline_md: Futures rise as tech rebounds: Dow +0.19%, S&P 500 +0.44%, Nasdaq 100 +0.86% (5:03 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: Dow futures were at 51,589, S&P 500 futures at 7,850.50 and Nasdaq 100 futures at 31,236.75.

items.headline_md: Nasdaq had its worst day since mid-August on Thursday, falling more than 1%
items.summary_md: CNBC tied the sell-off to OpenAI's lower-than-expected revenue figure (A1).

items.headline_md: Oil eases after Trump rules out Iran strikes before the midterms: Brent $102.65 (−1.6%), WTI $90.45 (−1.1%); gold up 1.3% to $4,209.20 (5:03 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: Brent had jumped more than 4% Thursday to above $104.

items.headline_md: 10-year Treasury yield steady at 5.231% (5:13 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: That's little changed from Thursday's close.

items.headline_md: Bitcoin gains 1.9% to about $83,245 (5:13 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: It's up about $1,569 on the day.

items.headline_md: Premarket movers: T-Mobile −7.4%, AT&T −6.4%, Verizon −5.6%, SpaceX +3.8%, Delta −1.5% (5:13 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: The telecoms are sliding on SpaceX's spectrum deal (T1), and Delta on its cut outlook (B1).

items.headline_md: Phoenix, AZ: Sunny and breezy, high near 102°F, low around 81°F tonight; Wind Advisory in effect
items.summary_md: Gusts up to 20 mph today and a 3% rain chance (7% tonight); the NWS Wind Advisory runs until 5 PM AZ Sunday, Oct 11.

items.headline_md: Show Low, AZ: Sunny, high near 76°F, low around 53°F tonight
items.summary_md: Rain chance is 3% today and 10% tonight with no amounts forecast, and there are no active alerts.

items.headline_md: Snowflake, AZ: Sunny, high near 81°F, low around 53°F tonight
items.summary_md: Rain chance is 3% today and 8% tonight with no amounts forecast, and there are no active alerts.

items.headline_md: Mark Zuckerberg has an image problem, so why is Meta's business booming?
items.summary_md: The BBC's Lily Jamali digs into why Meta keeps growing into a $2tn company despite addiction lawsuits and a new film that paints its founder as a villain.
